items.title: The Institutional Flight-to-Quality Rotation Is On So I Buy Alphabet
items.summary: Alphabet has slid nearly 19% in a month while institutions quietly shift toward quality. One investor keeps buying each dip, yet a negative cash flow figure and heavy share-sale capacity could still turn this bet sour.

items.title: EU drafts curbs targeting addictive social media features and AI chatbots - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- European Union regulators are preparing a fresh legislative assault on digital platforms, targeting addictive design mechanics and conversational artificial intelligence designed to drive compulsive engagement. The draft measures, part of an upcoming "Digital Fairness Act" reported by Bloomberg News, would mandate that tech companies allow adult users to disable features that encourage excessive use while also reining in AI chatbots that simulate personal relationships.

items.title: Why Ousting Nvidia’s CEO May Be Worse Than the Scandal Itself
items.summary: Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Megaspeed exec, who is suspected of being a Chinese spy, exposes the glaring lack of a succession plan at a firm that is central to the AI buildout.

items.title: Nvidia slides as CEO Huang faces board scrutiny over affair with alleged spy
items.summary: SEOUL/SYDNEY, Nov 9 (Reuters) - Nvidia shares declined on Monday after an internal investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort put his future at the AI chipmaker under scrutiny. The internal probe followed a media report that Huang had a close relationship with a Chinese businesswoman who allegedly passed information to ‌Beijing.

items.title: JPMorgan Just Removed Alphabet From Its Analyst Focus List
items.summary: Google's search queries just hit a five-year growth high, yet revenue lagged far behind. JPMorgan spotted the gap, and it is steering its near-term conviction toward a rival while keeping a bullish long-term view.

items.title: JPMorgan Just Added Meta Platforms to Its Analyst Focus List
items.summary: Meta's stock had slid for a month when JPMorgan quietly handed it a coveted spot, with no rating and no price target attached. What did the bank see in the ad numbers, and what risks still hide behind the AI spending spree?

items.title: Exclusive: Former Meta and OpenAI Contractor Sama Liquidates, Citing Lawsuits
items.summary: The embattled AI data annotation firm Sama is winding down its operations and liquidating its assets, according to a letter to creditors reviewed by TIME.

items.title: H.C. Wainwright’s $90 Target Says Oklo’s Selloff Went Too Far
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOn Nov. 9, H. C. Wainwright repeated its Buy rating and $90 price target on Oklo.
